revised_prompts: Create one photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor. The camera observes a paved campus walkway beside a building with benches and planted edges, painted loading-bay concrete, and partial shadow from a nearby structure with clear subject detail. Use a front-oblique view at slightly distant framing; keep natural perspective, realistic scale, and enough surrounding context to judge body support. The visible subject is an older adult man with a stocky build wearing a charcoal cardigan and practical shoes, subdued gray and olive clothing, seated on the floor while sorting a small work item, with the pelvis grounded and the head and chest raised. Make the composition a plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, with the subject clearly visible, a cart near one edge, and ample negative space around the subject. Use ordinary photographic detail and restrained contrast rather than a cinematic or advertising look. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or artificial annotation.
